title: Grill — harness stacks fix round + improvements

switch-now-live.title: What should "Switch to next account now" do while the task's run is live?
switch-now-live.display: Switch after the current turn ends

history-lifetime.title: How should the per-stack swap history be stored and how long is it kept?
history-lifetime.display: Kept with the stack, capped per stack

history-cap.title: How many swap events to keep per stack before pruning the oldest?

history-events.title: Which events go into the swap history?
history-events.display: Automatic retries after a reset; Blocked outcomes; Swaps completed at boot; Moves off an unusable account; Manual switches; Limit swaps

codex-per-model.title: Codex "You've hit your usage limit for <model>" — how should a per-model limit be scoped?
codex-per-model.display: Cool the account for that model only

mirror-backups.title: Mirror provenance: what happens to a backup's own files and keys the mirror overwrites?
mirror-backups.display: Back up everything overwritten + a Restore action

mirror-preview.title: When does the save-time mirror preview appear?
mirror-preview.display: Only when something on a backup would be overwritten or removed

clear-cooldown.title: What does "Clear cooldown" do?
clear-cooldown.display: Delete the account's cooldown for every task

cooldown-message.title: Show the provider's own limit message next to a cooling account?
cooldown-message.display: Reason + message (message in a tooltip/detail line)

retry-test-seam.title: The automatic retry waits at least 10 s (hard-coded). May the e2e shorten it with an env override?
retry-test-seam.display: Yes — `AGETOR_HARNESS_RETRY_MIN_MS`, honored only under NODE_ENV=test or the e2e backend flag

delivery.title: How should this ship?
delivery.display: One branch, a commit per wave; you open the PR

manual-no-cooldown.title: A manual switch (picker, CLI, switch now) never cools the old account and never marks it tried
manual-no-cooldown.value: Confirmed: only a provider limit cools an account; a manual move just picks the next usable member.

switch-now-none.title: Switch now with no other usable account is refused up front, before anything is stopped
switch-now-none.value: 409 with the per-member reasons (cooling until …, logged out, …); the live run keeps going.

provenance-edited.title: A file/key the mirror wrote and the backup later edited is never removed by deletion propagation
provenance-edited.value: Kept, with a warning naming it; provenance for it is dropped.

safe-mode-unown.title: Switching full → safe mirror stops owning hooks/permissions but leaves the backup's current values in place
safe-mode-unown.value: Provenance rows for keys safe mode no longer mirrors are dropped; nothing on the backup is deleted.

stack-concurrency.title: Stack edits carry the `updatedAt` they were based on; a mismatch answers 409
stack-concurrency.value: Webview: toast "This stack changed elsewhere — reloaded", the editor reloads with the current stack. CLI: `stack edit` always sends the updatedAt it just fetched; a 409 says to re-run.

cli-lookup.title: CLI stack references resolve as exact id → exact label → unique id prefix
cli-lookup.value: A label shared by two stacks is an error listing both ids, like an ambiguous task prefix.

picker-outside.title: The RunPanel account picker keeps outside-stack accounts selectable, grouped and labelled
picker-outside.value: we should not have this type of picker for out of the stack.
picker-outside.recommended: Two groups: "This stack — keeps the conversation" (with n/m and cooling marks) and "Other accounts — starts a fresh session". The select shows a spinner and stays disabled while a switch copies.

quota-display.title: Per-member quota shows the stored snapshot with its age; past 20 minutes it's marked stale
quota-display.value: Webview: compact meter per member (5h / weekly), from the app's usage map. CLI `stack ls/show`: the same from GET /usage. No force refresh from the CLI.

quota-exhausted-rule.title: A quota snapshot counts as exhausted when any blocking window (Claude 5h/weekly, Codex session/weekly) is at 100% and no credits meter has headroom; its reset is the latest exhausted window's

cloud-env-evidence.title: AWS/Azure/Vertex/Google credentials in the process env count as Claude login evidence only with a provider selector (CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK/VERTEX/FOUNDRY), and then as "unknown"
